title: Scoping the AI Ethics Landscape: No Matrix Configured
unit_of_analysis: Published AI ethics frameworks and guidelines
epistemological_rationale: A broad interpretive scoping of the AI ethics landscape does not yet warrant structured extraction dimensions.

research_questions.text: What ethical principles are most commonly foregrounded in AI governance frameworks published since 2018?

inclusion_criteria.criterion: Document explicitly addresses ethical principles or guidelines for AI systems

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Grey literature without peer review or institutional endorsement
